Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance

Class RadialInfiniteInfluence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance.RadialInfiniteInfluence
final class RadialInfiniteInfluence extends Object
Positive spectral quadrature of the infinite radial diffusion influence function.

Integrates the unit-rate response over frequency using the modulus of the order-one Bessel functions. A low-frequency remainder and positive resolved high-frequency tail preserve both representable time limits. Controlled Taylor and exponential bounds avoid unnecessary transcendental evaluations. A short initial tail defers the complete immutable grid until a query needs it, preserving the global nodes and accumulation order. This internal scalar kernel is independent of fluid models and reservoir histories.

1.0
Author:
